title: Earth Beet Dumplings
description: Fermented Ukrainian beet dumplings with a chewy texture, perfect for a brunch mood, featuring a unique blue color and sashimi-cut presentation, served on a bamboo tray.
instructions: In a large bowl, combine grated beets, buckwheat flour, blue food coloring, salt, and sugar.
Gradually add water to the bowl and mix until a dough forms.
Knead the dough for 10 minutes until it becomes smooth and elastic.
Place the dough in a warm place and let it ferment for 2 hours.
Divide the dough into small pieces and shape into dumplings.
Bring a large pot of water to a boil and cook the dumplings for 10 minutes.
Remove the dumplings from the water and let them cool.
Cut the dumplings into sashimi-style pieces and serve on a bamboo tray.
